title: Two vehicles are attempting to park at same spot when vehicle in front has crossed the spot.
situation: Two vehicles are attempting to park at same spot when vehicle in front has crossed the spot.
communication_type: Inter Vehicle & Traffic Signal Communication, Between Pedestrian and Detector present roadside
description: Two vehicles are trying to park at the same spot but the vehicle in front has already moved over the space partially but wants to back up and park while vehicle at the back has entered the parking space.
